text.p: Italian futures ended a thin holiday session with modest gains around the middle of the day's range. Traders said mostly sideways trading with dip in afternoon in T-bonds as sellers emerged.

"There's little been done today, everything's very calm and there's not much liquidity about," one trader said. "Those who wanted to take out positions have already done so and are no longer doing much at all," he added.
Operators said speculation of a possible Bundesbank repo rate hike on Tuesday had eased and the market now awaited with some trepidation U.S. July retail sales data on Wednesday.
